payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Ada, Jaymie, Siobhan, Suzette

payload.content: Hello all, I see several high-priority tasks related to mobile-development and frontend improvements. I am skilled in mobile-development with availability of 9 hours. I am considering picking ISSUE-0001::triage or ISSUE-0001::review since they have reasonable costs for me, but I am open to suggestions if anyone else prefers those tasks or if better task coverage is needed.

Hello all, I am Ada. I have 4 hours available and strong skills in mobile-development (0.97) and frontend (0.65). I see Jaymie is considering ISSUE-0001::triage or ISSUE-0001::review. I notice triage has a cost of 2.23 for me and review 2.79, but triage fits better in my availability. I am also considering ISSUE-0002::review or test for frontend improvements, but these have higher costs for me. I propose I take ISSUE-0001::triage and Jaymie takes review to avoid overlap. What do others think?

To optimize team coverage, I encourage others to share their availability and preferences, especially for the tasks ISSUE-0001::docs, ISSUE-0001::test, and ISSUE-0002::implement, which are still unclaimed. I am open to adjusting my choice if others have stronger preferences or better cost-efficiency for these tasks.

Hello all, I have 8 hours available and strong skills in ui-ux-design (0.92). I am interested in the ISSUE-0002::implement task since it aligns well with my skills and availability, though it has a moderate cost for me. I will consider other tasks if anyone else prefers that one or if better coverage is needed for other high-priority tasks.

Considering the remaining tasks, I am also open to ISSUE-0001::docs or test, but those have very high private costs for me, so they are less preferred. Let me know if anyone else is interested in those tasks.

Hello team, I have 4 hours available with top skills in mobile-development (0.99) and ui-ux-design (0.81). I am considering taking on ISSUE-0001::docs or ISSUE-0001::triage as they fit my availability and skill set with relatively lower cost (2.75 and 2.20 respectively). I want to avoid overlap with Ada and Jaymie's interests, so I am open to suggestions if anyone prefers these tasks more or if I should consider another task.

Hi all, based on the current discussions, I propose to take ISSUE-0001::review since it fits my skills and availability well and Ada can take ISSUE-0001::triage as suggested. Suzette can consider ISSUE-0001::docs to avoid overlap, and Siobhan can focus on ISSUE-0002::implement. This way, we maximize coverage, minimize cost, and avoid duplicate claims. Thoughts?

Just to confirm, I am planning to take ISSUE-0001::review with my 9 hours availability and good skill match. Please let me know if anyone else is interested or if we need to adjust for better coverage. Thanks!

I agree with Jaymie's proposal: I will take ISSUE-0001::triage as it fits my availability and cost well. Jaymie takes ISSUE-0001::review, Suzette takes ISSUE-0001::docs, and Siobhan takes ISSUE-0002::implement to optimize coverage and minimize overlap. If anyone has any concerns or alternative preferences, please share now.

I agree with the proposed plan: I will take ISSUE-0002::implement as it aligns with my skills and availability well. This plan seems optimal for maximizing coverage and minimizing cost. Looking forward to others' confirmation.
Reminder to team: I will take ISSUE-0002::implement if no objections. Please confirm your choices so we can avoid duplicate claims and maximize our team's effectiveness.

Hello all, I agree with the proposed plan to maximize coverage and minimize cost: Jaymie takes ISSUE-0001::review, Ada takes ISSUE-0001::triage, Siobhan takes ISSUE-0002::implement, and I will take ISSUE-0001::docs. This distribution aligns well with our skills and availability and avoids task overlap. Looking forward to final confirmations and execution.

Confirming my intention to take ISSUE-0001::docs. This will complement Jaymie's ISSUE-0001::review, Ada's ISSUE-0001::triage, and Siobhan's ISSUE-0002::implement for optimized task distribution. Looking forward to finalizing our assignments.
